description: Create all new TypeScript source files: src/index.css, src/main.tsx, src/App.tsx, src/hooks/useConfetti.ts, src/hooks/useTypingAnimation.ts, and all 10 components (GoldParticles, Navigation, IntroScene, BirthdayHero, RoastSection, MemoryGallery, BirthdayLetter, BirthdayCake, WishGenerator, BirthdayFinale). This FEAT depends on FEAT-001 being complete (tsconfig, tailwind palette, birthday.ts config all exist). After this FEAT, `npm run build` must pass with zero TypeScript errors.
steps: Step 1 — Create src/index.css at c:\Users\tejat\OneDrive\Desktop\akki\src\index.css. Full content as specified: Tailwind directives, CSS custom properties on :root (--obsidian, --midnight, --gold, --ivory, --rose, --silver), body styles (background #08090D, color #FFF4E5, font Inter), .font-serif rule (Cormorant Garamond + Playfair Display), .text-gold gradient rule (background linear-gradient + webkit-background-clip + webkit-text-fill-color), .glass-card glassmorphism rule, all 8 @keyframes (floatParticle, twinkle, flicker, shootingStar, cinematicReveal, goldGlow, lightRay, plus a pulse-glow for candle flames), html scroll-behavior smooth, custom scrollbar styles, prefers-reduced-motion media query.

Step 2 — Create src/main.tsx at c:\Users\tejat\OneDrive\Desktop\akki\src\main.tsx. Exact content: `import React from 'react'; import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client'; import App from './App'; import './index.css'; ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(<React.StrictMode><App /></React.StrictMode>);`

Step 3 — Create src/hooks/useConfetti.ts at c:\Users\tejat\OneDrive\Desktop\akki\src\hooks\useConfetti.ts. Export two standalone functions (NOT a hook — no React state needed): triggerConfetti(options?: Record<string, unknown>): void — fires canvas-confetti with colors ['#D9B777', '#B77B85', '#FFF4E5', '#C5C7D0'] from 3 origins (center y:0.6, left x:0 y:0.6, right x:1 y:0.6), particleCount 100/60/60, spread 80/55/55. gentleConfetti(): void — softer burst, particleCount 40, spread 60, gravity 0.5, same color palette. Import: `import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';` (default import, typed by @types/canvas-confetti).

Step 4 — Create src/hooks/useTypingAnimation.ts at c:\Users\tejat\OneDrive\Desktop\akki\src\hooks\useTypingAnimation.ts. Export: `export function useTypingAnimation(fullText: string, charDelay = 20, startDelay = 0)` returning `{ displayedText: string, isDone: boolean, startTyping: () => void }`. Internal state: displayedText (useState<string>('')), isDone (useState<boolean>(false)), hasStarted (useRef<boolean>(false)), intervalRef (useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null)), timerRef (useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)). startTyping() sets hasStarted.current = true, starts a setTimeout(startDelay) that then starts setInterval(charDelay) to advance displayedText one char at a time until fullText.length reached, then sets isDone true. Cleanup on unmount: clear both refs. Do NOT use a boolean state for 'started' — use useRef to avoid stale closure issues.

Step 5 — Create src/components/GoldParticles.tsx at c:\Users\tejat\OneDrive\Desktop\akki\src\components\GoldParticles.tsx. Interface: ParticleData { id: number; top: string; left: string; size: number; color: string; duration: number; delay: number; }. useMemo to generate array of 20 ParticleData objects with Math.random(). Each particle: position fixed, pointerEvents none, borderRadius '50%', background from color, width/height from size (2–4px), animation `floatParticle ${duration}s linear ${delay}s infinite`. Outer wrapper: fixed inset-0, pointerEvents none, zIndex 1, overflow hidden.

Step 6 — Create src/components/Navigation.tsx at c:\Users\tejat\OneDrive\Desktop\akki\src\components\Navigation.tsx. Fixed top, full width, z-50. State: scrolled (boolean, true when window.scrollY > 60), menuOpen (boolean). useEffect scroll listener sets scrolled. Background: transparent → rgba(16,18,28,0.92) with backdrop-blur transition based on scrolled. Brand: 'AKKI ✨' in Cormorant Garamond gold italic text. Nav links array: [{label: 'Home', href: '#home'}, {label: 'The Roast', href: '#roast'}, {label: 'Memories', href: '#memories'}, {label: 'Letter', href: '#letter'}, {label: 'Make a Wish', href: '#wish'}]. Desktop: hidden md:flex gap-8. Mobile: Lucide Menu icon button, slide-down panel with AnimatePresence (motion.div initial y:-20 opacity:0 → animate y:0 opacity:1). Back-to-top: fixed bottom-6 right-6, appears when scrollY > 400, gold circular button with Lucide ArrowUp icon, onClick scrolls to top. Link click handler: prevent default, querySelector(href).scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth' }), close mobile menu.

Step 7 — Create src/components/IntroScene.tsx at c:\Users\tejat\OneDrive\Desktop\akki\src\components\IntroScene.tsx. Props: `{ onComplete: () => void }`. Full-screen fixed overlay zIndex 100. Background radial-gradient from #08090D to #10121C. 15 floating gold particle divs (similar to GoldParticles but generated inline with Math.random). Center spotlight: absolute div with radial-gradient rgba(217,183,119,0.08) circle 600px. Gift box: motion.div with 🎁 at fontSize '5rem', animate scale [1, 1.05, 1] repeat. Text sequence using Framer Motion motion.div with initial opacity:0 y:20, animate opacity:1 y:0, each with different transition.delay: (1) 'TONIGHT, THE SPOTLIGHT IS YOURS.' at delay:0.8s letter-spaced silver caps, (2) 'THIS LITTLE SURPRISE IS MADE FOR…' at delay:2.2s, (3) 'AKKI' at delay:3.5s in Cormorant Garamond 8xl-9xl with gold gradient text + textShadow '0 0 60px rgba(217,183,119,0.6)', (4) warning italic text at delay:5s. Button 'UNWRAP YOUR SURPRISE ✨' at delay:6.5s: isAnimating state guard, onClick calls triggerConfetti() from useConfetti, then setTimeout 800ms → onComplete(). 'Skip intro' link: absolute top-4 right-4, small Inter text, onClick calls onComplete() immediately. Wrap entire overlay in AnimatePresence with exit={{ opacity:0, scale:1.05 }} transition duration 0.8s.

Step 8 — Create src/components/BirthdayHero.tsx at c:\Users\tejat\OneDrive\Desktop\akki\src\components\BirthdayHero.tsx. Section id='home', minHeight '100vh', background linear-gradient 180deg #08090D → #10121C → #08090D. 3 light ray divs: absolute, 2px wide, 120% height, rotated at -20deg / 0deg / 20deg, background linear-gradient transparent→rgba(217,183,119,0.06)→transparent, animation lightRay with CSS var --rotation set per ray, opacity ~0.05. Content centered via flex. Eyebrow: 'THE MAIN CHARACTER OF TODAY' in Inter tracking-widest text-xs text-[#D9B777]. Headline: word-by-word Framer Motion stagger — split 'HAPPY BIRTHDAY, AKKI.' into words, each word is motion.span with initial opacity:0 y:30 → whileInView opacity:1 y:0 viewport once:true, stagger delay index*0.15. The word 'AKKI.' gets gold gradient class + textShadow. Subtext + subtitle in Inter text-[#C5C7D0] and text-[#FFF4E5]/70. Two buttons: (1) 'EXPLORE YOUR SURPRISE ↓' with Lucide ChevronDown — border border-[#D9B777] text-[#D9B777] hover:bg-[#D9B777]/10, onClick scrolls to #roast; (2) 'A MESSAGE FOR YOU 💌' with Lucide Mail — bg-[#D9B777] text-[#08090D] font-semibold hover:bg-[#f0d080], onClick scrolls to #letter. Both buttons use explicit onClick types: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void.

Step 9 — Create src/components/RoastSection.tsx at c:\Users\tejat\OneDrive\Desktop\akki\src\components\RoastSection.tsx. Section id='roast', dark bg with subtle gold gradient at top. Import birthdayConfig from '../config/birthday'. State: expanded Record<number, boolean> initialized as {}. Section heading + subtitle centered. Grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 px-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto. Map birthdayConfig.roastCards: each card is motion.div with initial opacity:0 y:40, whileInView opacity:1 y:0, viewport once:true, transition delay index*0.1. Card has glass-card class + border-t-2 border-[#D9B777] p-6 cursor-pointer rounded-sm. tabIndex={0} for keyboard. onKeyDown: if key is Enter or Space, toggle expanded[card.id]. onClick toggles expanded[card.id]. Collapsed: shows emoji (text-4xl), title (Cormorant Garamond gold tracking-widest text-sm), and 'Click to reveal ↓' small italic hint. Expanded message uses AnimatePresence + motion.div initial height:0 opacity:0 → animate height:'auto' opacity:1 overflow:hidden. Closing line at bottom of section: 'ROAST COMPLETE. LOVE LEVEL: UNLIMITED. ❤️' centered gold italic Cormorant.

Step 10 — Create src/components/MemoryGallery.tsx at c:\Users\tejat\OneDrive\Desktop\akki\src\components\MemoryGallery.tsx. Section id='memories', dark bg. Import birthdayConfig. State: lightboxIndex (number | null, null = closed). Touch state: touchStartX useRef(0). CSS columns masonry: style={{ columnCount: computed (1 mobile, 2 md, 3 lg, 4 xl) based on useWindowWidth hook OR use Tailwind CSS columns-2 md:columns-3 lg:columns-4 xl:columns-4 via className — use Tailwind className approach as simpler}. Each photo card: div with className 'break-inside-avoid mb-4 relative overflow-hidden group border border-[#D9B777]/30 rounded-sm cursor-pointer'. Image: {e.currentTarget.style.display='none'; /* show fallback */}} />. Fallback div behind img: absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br from-[#10121C] to-[#1a1a2e] text-[#D9B777] text-4xl (camera emoji). Hover overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity. Caption: absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent p-3 translate-y-full group-hover:translate-y-0 transition-transform text-[#FFF4E5] text-xs. Number badge: absolute top-2 right-2 bg-black/60 text-[#D9B777] text-xs px-2 py-0.5. Lightbox: fixed inset-0 bg-black/92 z-50, centered image max-h-[80vh] object-contain w-auto, caption below, counter 'XX / 26' top-center, close button top-right (Lucide X), prev/next buttons (Lucide ChevronLeft/ChevronRight). useEffect: keydown listener ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Escape when lightboxIndex !== null. Touch: onTouchStart saves e.touches[0].clientX to touchStartX.current; onTouchEnd: delta = touchStartX.current - e.changedTouches[0].clientX, if delta > 50 next, if delta < -50 prev. Click on backdrop closes; click on image calls e.stopPropagation(). body.style.overflow control on lightbox open/close. Framer Motion: lightbox AnimatePresence + motion.div initial scale:0.92 opacity:0 animate scale:1 opacity:1.

Step 11 — Create src/components/BirthdayLetter.tsx at c:\Users\tejat\OneDrive\Desktop\akki\src\components\BirthdayLetter.tsx. Section id='letter', dark bg with subtle rose radial glow (position absolute, pointer-events none, radial-gradient rgba(183,123,133,0.06)). Section heading 'JOKES ASIDE… THIS PART IS REAL.' Import birthdayConfig, useTypingAnimation. State: isOpen (boolean). const { displayedText, isDone, startTyping } = useTypingAnimation(birthdayConfig.letter.body, 15). useEffect: when isOpen becomes true, call startTyping(). Envelope: w-80 mx-auto relative, perspective:1000px on wrapper. Flap: div with clip-path polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 50% 100%), background linear-gradient ivory/gold, motion.div rotateX: isOpen ? -180 : 0, transformOrigin:'top', transition duration 0.8s. Envelope body: bg-[#FFF4E5]/10 border border-[#D9B777]/40 p-8 rounded-b-lg. Letter card inside: motion.div initial y:40 opacity:0, animate when isOpen: y:-60 opacity:1. Button 'OPEN YOUR LETTER 💌': gold border, below envelope, onClick setIsOpen(true), disabled when isOpen. Full letter area: AnimatePresence, when isOpen render motion.div (initial opacity:0 y:20, animate opacity:1 y:0 delay:0.5) with ivory/dark bg, Cormorant salutation + Inter body with displayed text + blinking cursor span animate opacity [1,0] repeat when !isDone. 'Read all at once' button: small link below letter, onClick calls startTyping with instant mode — actually just sets state to full text by calling startTyping() multiple times is wrong; instead expose a skipToEnd: () => void from the hook that sets displayedText to fullText and isDone to true. Add skipToEnd to the hook signature. After letter: postLetterLine in gold italic Cormorant centered.

Step 12 — Create src/components/BirthdayCake.tsx at c:\Users\tejat\OneDrive\Desktop\akki\src\components\BirthdayCake.tsx. Exported component (no section wrapper — wrapped in App.tsx's wish section). Import gentleConfetti from '../hooks/useConfetti'. State: flamesVisible boolean[] (Array(5).fill(true)), wishRevealed boolean, key for re-render (number). Heading 'MAKE A WISH, BIRTHDAY STAR.' Cake: pure CSS using divs. Plate: 300×20px ellipse bg-[#C5C7D0]/20 rounded-full mx-auto. Bottom tier: 260×60px bg-gradient-to-b from-[#FFF4E5] to-[#f5e6cc] rounded-b-2xl mx-auto border-b-4 border-[#D9B777]. Middle tier: 200×50px same style. Top tier: 150×45px same. Frosting: 4px gold line on top of each tier. Candles row centered on top tier: 5 divs each 10×36px bg-gradient-to-b from-[#FFF4E5] to-[#f0d4a0] inline-block mx-1. Flame: 10×16px div per candle, bg-gradient-to-b from-[#ffd700] to-[#ff6b35] rounded-[50%_50%_30%_30%] absolute -top-4 left-0 CSS animation flicker 0.4s ease-in-out infinite stagger delay index*0.08s. Each candle position relative. When flame[i] is false: flame div hidden, show smoke div (small grey div fading upward via CSS animation). Button 'BLOW OUT THE CANDLES ✨': onClick iterates i 0..4 with setTimeout(i*150ms) setting flamesVisible[i]=false, after 5*150+200ms sets wishRevealed=true and calls gentleConfetti(). Wish text: AnimatePresence, when wishRevealed render motion.div fade-in with a fixed wish: the first item from birthdayConfig.wishes array, gold italic Cormorant, text-center. 'Light the candles again 🕯️': small button resets flamesVisible to all-true, wishRevealed to false.

Step 13 — Create src/components/WishGenerator.tsx at c:\Users\tejat\OneDrive\Desktop\akki\src\components\WishGenerator.tsx. Import birthdayConfig. State: currentIndex (number | null, null). Card: dark bg with boxShadow '0 0 30px rgba(217,183,119,0.25)', border border-[#D9B777]/40, p-8 rounded-sm max-w-lg mx-auto. Heading 'YOUR LITTLE BOX OF GOOD THINGS.' in tracking-widest small caps. AnimatePresence mode='wait': when currentIndex is null show prompt text 'Click below to reveal a little wish…' else show wish text from birthdayConfig.wishes[currentIndex] in Cormorant italic large gold. Key on wish div = currentIndex so AnimatePresence re-animates each new one (initial opacity:0 y:10 → animate opacity:1 y:0 exit opacity:0 y:-10). Button 'REVEAL A LITTLE WISH ✨': gold outline, onClick: picks random index different from currentIndex using Math.floor(Math.random()*wishes.length), retry if same.

Step 14 — Create src/components/BirthdayFinale.tsx at c:\Users\tejat\OneDrive\Desktop\akki\src\components\BirthdayFinale.tsx. Section id='finale', minHeight 100vh, overflow hidden, background linear-gradient 180deg #10121C 0% #0a0015 100%. Import triggerConfetti. State: celebrateKey (number, 0). Stars: useMemo array of 50 objects {id, top, left, delay} used to render 50 divs each 2×2px bg-white rounded-full absolute animation twinkle random delay 0–8s. Moon: absolute top-16 right-16 (or top-right corner), 120×120px div background radial-gradient circle #FFF4E5 → rgba(255,244,229,0.3) rounded-full boxShadow '0 0 60px rgba(255,244,229,0.4)'. Shooting star: absolute div top-1/4 right-1/4 width:2px height:2px bg-white, CSS animation shootingStar 8s ease-in-out infinite. Fireworks (key={celebrateKey} so they restart): 5 motion.div 'firework' emitters at different absolute positions (top:30% left:20%, top:20% right:25%, top:40% left:50%, top:25% left:70%, top:35% right:15%). Each emitter renders 12 'ray' divs: absolute width:2px height:30px, each rotated by ray*30deg, transformOrigin bottom, motion.div with initial scaleY:0 opacity:1, animate scaleY:1 opacity:0, transition delay:ray*0.04s duration:0.6s. Firework colors cycle through gold, rose, ivory, silver per firework index. Text content (Framer Motion whileInView stagger, viewport once:true): line1 (small gold tracking-widest), line2 (large gold Cormorant), body paragraph (Inter silver), headline 'HAPPY BIRTHDAY, AKKI. ❤️' (massive Cormorant white 6xl–9xl), tagline, signature italic. Button 'CELEBRATE AGAIN 🎉': bg-[#D9B777] text-[#08090D] px-8 py-3, onClick: setCelebrateKey(k=>k+1); triggerConfetti(). Footer: <footer> centered text-xs text-[#C5C7D0]/40 pb-8 pt-4, text 'AKKI\'S BIRTHDAY EXPERIENCE · MADE WITH LOVE ✨'.

Step 15 — Create src/App.tsx at c:\Users\tejat\OneDrive\Desktop\akki\src\App.tsx. Exact structure as specified: useState(true) for showIntro, AnimatePresence wrapping IntroScene when showIntro, motion.main fading in when !showIntro. Import all 10 components. The wish section: <section id='wish' style={{background:'#08090D', padding:'80px 0'}}> wrapping both <BirthdayCake /> and <WishGenerator />. No react-router-dom import — this is a single-page scroll app. Remove react-router-dom from package.json dependencies (run `npm uninstall react-router-dom`) to keep the bundle clean.

Step 16 — Run `npm run build` from c:\Users\tejat\OneDrive\Desktop\akki. Fix any TypeScript or Vite errors found. Common issues to watch for: (a) implicit 'any' types on event handlers — add explicit React.MouseEvent/KeyboardEvent/TouchEvent types; (b) non-null assertions on getElementById — add `!` or null check; (c) canvas-confetti type: confetti() call options must match confetti.Options type; (d) useRef initial value must match type: useRef<number>(0) not useRef(0) where number is needed; (e) CSS animation string values — if Tailwind JIT purges custom keyframe names from index.css, ensure keyframe names exactly match animation: property values; (f) AnimatePresence requires unique key props on children. After fixing all errors, `npm run build` must exit 0.

findings: Build passed clean on first attempt — exit 0, zero TypeScript errors, zero Vite bundler errors. All 10 components created as .tsx, both hooks as .ts, App.tsx assembled as single-page scroll with no react-router-dom. react-router-dom uninstalled successfully. dist/ produced: index.html, assets/index-*.css (17.71 kB), assets/index-*.js (306.01 kB), all 26 images copied. No old .jsx files remain in src/. Notable implementation choices: (1) IntroScene uses local 'visible' state + AnimatePresence exit rather than removing from DOM via parent immediately, allowing the exit animation to play before onComplete fires; (2) useTypingAnimation uses an indexRef to track position instead of a closure variable, avoiding stale closure bugs in setInterval; (3) MemoryGallery uses Tailwind CSS columns-* classes for masonry rather than a useWindowWidth hook, keeping the component simpler.
